description: This file defines the LoggerLayoutHtml class, a layout for logging events in HTML table format within the log4php logging framework. It includes configurations for displaying location info, title, and generates HTML headers, footers, and formatted log entries.

classes.name: LoggerLayoutHtml
classes.description: A layout class for formatting log events as HTML table rows for display in web pages.

methods.name: setLocationInfo
methods.description: Sets whether to include source location info (file name and line number) in the log output.

methods.name: getLocationInfo
methods.description: Returns whether location info output is enabled.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the HTML document title for the log output.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the current title setting for the log HTML.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the content generated by this layout, which is 'text/html'.

methods.name: activateOptions
methods.description: Placeholder method; currently returns true without additional activation logic.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a given logging event as an HTML table row, including timestamp, thread, level, category, optional location info, and message.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Generates the HTML header including styles and initial table setup for the log display.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Generates the closing HTML tags for the log display.
